description: ODC: the REFUSAL of RENAMING an index to a name with more than 28 characters: the ODC Studio truncates the name silently (measured on 2026-09-23: UQ_WfCovMilestone_ProjectName became UQ_WfCovMilestone_ProjectNam). On `create` the kernel writes the name the Studio keeps and reports it in nameTruncations (D2, frictions 3); on `rename` the name is an explicit choice of the author and the kernel refuses, in both lanes.
